issues.problem: Misuse 1 (部長が反対して新しい計画の話の腰を折った) is not clearly wrong: it reads naturally as the manager cutting into the discussion of the plan.
issues.action: Replaced with a clear misuse: a construction project (not anyone's talk) being 'interrupted' by lack of funds; why now points to chūdan / tonza.

issues.problem: Context 4 (途中で話の腰を折らないでください before questions) is filled just as well by the near-synonym 口を挟む.
issues.action: Rewrote as a speaker protesting that the story was just getting good (せっかく盛り上がってきたところなのに), so breaking the flow is the point.

issues.problem: Context 1 (社長と二人きりのエレベーターは息が詰まった) was slightly awkward and fits the near-synonym 間が持たない (awkward silence) equally well.
issues.action: Replaced with being shut in a small room all day (狭い部屋に一日中こもっていると息が詰まる).

issues.problem: Story checked: Han Xin's river-backed formation against Zhao (Battle of Jingxing), with a hidden force taking the Zhao camp, Shiji 淮陰侯列伝. Accurate.
